title: Maxpar Antibody Labeling for Imaging Mass Cytometry
author: Marda Jorgensen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bf5jjq4n

steps.title: Prepare Metal-Loaded Polymer
steps.instruction: Load the polymer with lanthanide metal and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Spin the polymer tube for 10 seconds in a microfuge to ensure reagent is at the bottom.
Resuspend the polymer with 95 μL of L-Buffer and mix thoroughly by pipetting.
Add 5 μL of lanthanide metal solution (final concentration: 2.5 mM in 100 μL) and mix thoroughly by pipetting.
Incubate at 37 °C for 30–40 minutes in a water bath or heat block.

steps.title: Reduce Antibody
steps.instruction: Prepare and partially reduce the stock antibody.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 μg of stock antibody in up to 400 μL R-Buffer to a 50 kDa filter.
Centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 10 minutes at room temperature (RT).
Dilute 0.5 M TCEP stock to 4 mM in R-Buffer by mixing 8 μL of 0.5 M TCEP stock with 992 μL of R-Buffer (100 μL of 4 mM TCEP-R-Buffer is required per antibody).
Discard column flow-through from centrifugation.
Add 100 μL of the 4 mM TCEP-R-Buffer to each antibody and mix by pipetting.
Incubate at 37 °C in a water bath or heat block for exactly 30 minutes.

steps.title: Purify Lanthanide-Loaded Polymer
steps.instruction: Wash the metal-loaded polymer using a 3 kDa filter.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μL of L-Buffer to a 3 kDa filter.
Add the 100 μL metal-loaded polymer mixture to the filter and centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 25 minutes at RT.
Wash by adding 400 μL of C-Buffer to the filter and centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 30 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Purify Reduced Antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the partially reduced antibody using the 50 kDa filter.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve the 50 kDa filter from the 37 °C incubator.
Add 300 μL of C-Buffer to the filter and centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 10 minutes at RT.
Discard flow-through.
Repeat the wash by adding 400 μL of C-Buffer to the filter and centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 10 minutes at RT.

steps.title: Conjugate Polymer and Antibody
steps.instruction: Combine the purified polymer and antibody for conjugation.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve the 3 kDa filter (polymer) and 50 kDa filter (antibody) and discard any remaining flow-through.
Resuspend the lanthanide-loaded polymer in 60 μL of C-Buffer (total volume ~80 μL).
Transfer the resuspended polymer to the partially reduced antibody in the 50 kDa filter (final conjugation volume ~100 μL).
Mix gently by pipetting and incubate at 37 °C for 90 minutes.
Add 200 μL of W-buffer to the 100 μL conjugation mixture and centrifuge at 12,000 x g for 10 minutes.
Discard flow-through.
Repeat the wash three more times with W-Buffer (total of four washes), using 400 μL for subsequent washes.

steps.title: Quantify and Stabilize Conjugate
steps.instruction: Determine concentration and resuspend the conjugate in stabilization buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add ~80 μL of W-buffer to the 50 kDa filter to dilute the conjugate (in ~20 μL) to a volume of 100 μL; mix and rinse filter walls.
Quantify the conjugated antibody by measuring absorbance at 280 nm against a W-Buffer blank (expected recovery 60%).
Calculate the volume of antibody stabilization buffer (supplemented with 0.05% sodium azide) required for a final concentration of 0.5 mg/mL.
Centrifuge the 50 kDa filter at 12,000 x g for 10 minutes to remove W-Buffer.
Add the calculated volume of stabilization buffer minus the residual volume (~20 μL) to the filter.

steps.title: Recover and Store Conjugate
steps.instruction: Collect the final product and store.

substeps.instruction: Invert the 50 kDa filter over a new collection tube.
Centrifuge the inverted assembly at 1,000 x g for 2 minutes.
Store at 4 °C until titration.

steps.title: Titrate Conjugated Antibody
steps.instruction: Determine the optimum working concentration on the CyTOF instrument.

substeps.instruction: Titrate the antibody with relevant positive and negative controls using the following concentrations: 5 μg/mL, 2.5 μg/mL, 1.25 μg/mL, 0.62 μg/mL, 0.31 μg/mL, 0.16 μg/mL, and 0 μg/mL.
If necessary, dilute the antibody to the optimum working concentration in stabilization buffer and store at 4 °C.
